title: SEAWEED: SEAfloor WavelEt Extraction and Diagnostics
description: An automated workflow, with fixed default parameters, for extracting the effective wavelet (source signature with source and receiver ghosts) from marine seismic data when a recorded source signature is unavailable, with physical and statistical diagnostics from the water-layer multiples and a statistical estimate of the amplitude spectrum.
